scope: Exact four missing Crampon digital verse keys during initial automated collation; source existence independently checked with Crampon 1923 Wikisource.
rule: A secondary machine-readable dataset may omit a verse key or follow different numbering. Do not assert the verse is absent from the Catholic Bible, silently substitute another translation or publish Scripture from an unapproved witness.

exceptions.notes: Printed Crampon Psalter labels Ps. cxxxii (Vulg. cxxxi) and includes the corresponding verse 8. This is an explicit single-reference alias, not a general +1 Psalm rule.
Crampon 1923 printed text includes Judith XIII, 23. The pinned Scrollmapper transcription does not present this identical (chapter,verse) key.
Same printed Crampon verse as glo4.b10; may not be labelled absent just because a particular dataset lacks the key.
Crampon 1923 printed text includes Judith XIII, 25; pinned digital dataset lacks identical verse key. Do not infer that the Scripture is missing.
